queries:
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS overall_avg FROM eq
),
above AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_h, overall.overall_avg
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_h > overall.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS group_avg FROM above
)
SELECT a.equipref,
       a.avg_h AS avg_humidity,
       a.avg_h - a.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg,
       a.avg_h - g.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above a, grp g
WHERE a.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
),
above AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, overall.overall_avg
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.avg_hum > overall.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_avg
  FROM above
)
SELECT
  above.equipref,
  above.avg_hum AS avg_humidity,
  above.avg_hum - above.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg,
  above.avg_hum - grp.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above, grp
WHERE above.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND grp.group_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH per AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS a
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
  HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM per
),
above AS (
  SELECT p.equipref, p.a
  FROM per p, overall o
  WHERE p.a > o.m
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS g FROM above
)
SELECT
  ab.equipref,
  ab.a AS avg_humidity,
  ab.a - o.m AS exceeds_overall_avg,
  ab.a - g.g AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above ab, overall o, grp g
WHERE o.m IS NOT NULL AND g.g IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
WITH eq AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS a
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
  HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS o FROM eq
),
above AS (
  SELECT eq.equipref, eq.a
  FROM eq, overall
  WHERE eq.a > overall.o
),
gm AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) AS g
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE equipref IN (SELECT equipref FROM above)
)
SELECT above.equipref,
       above.a AS avg_humidity,
       above.a - overall.o AS exceeds_overall_avg,
       above.a - gm.g AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above, overall, gm
WHERE overall.o IS NOT NULL AND gm.g IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
